One-time setup required

Connect the admin securely.

Add the protected environment variables below once, then redeploy. They remain private and are never included in the website.

  1. BEVALINK_SESSION_SECRET
  2. GITHUB_TOKEN
  3. BEVALINK_ADMIN_PASSWORD (current login)
  4. SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (email reset)
